```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(phyloseq)
library(microbiomeMarker)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(writexl)
library(tibble)
library(here)

run_name    <- params$run_name
output_dir  <- params$output_dir
lda_cutoff  <- params$lda_cutoff
pval_cutoff <- params$pval_cutoff
prefix      <- paste0(run_name, "_")

dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## 1. Load Data

```{r load-data}
# MetaCyc pathway abundance (CPM, unmapped removed)
pathway_raw  <- read_excel(here("data", "pathway_abundance.xlsx"),
                            sheet = "pathway_cpm")
pathway_mat  <- as.matrix(pathway_raw[, -1])
rownames(pathway_mat) <- pathway_raw[[1]]

# Metadata
metadata <- read_excel(here("data", "metadata.xlsx"), sheet = "metadata")
metadata <- as.data.frame(metadata)
rownames(metadata) <- metadata$SampleID

# Align
common_samples  <- intersect(colnames(pathway_mat), rownames(metadata))
pathway_mat     <- pathway_mat[, common_samples]
metadata        <- metadata[common_samples, ]
metadata$Enterotype <- as.factor(metadata$Enterotype)

cat("Pathways:", nrow(pathway_mat),
    "| Samples:", ncol(pathway_mat), "\n")
cat("Enterotype distribution:\n")
print(table(metadata$Enterotype))
```

## 2. Build Phyloseq Object

```{r phyloseq}
ps_pathway <- phyloseq(
  otu_table(pathway_mat, taxa_are_rows = TRUE),
  sample_data(metadata)
)

# Filter: prevalence >= 10%
ps_filtered <- filter_taxa(ps_pathway, function(x) {
  sum(x > 0) / length(x) >= 0.10
}, TRUE)

cat("Pathways after prevalence filter:", ntaxa(ps_filtered), "\n")
```

## 3. LEfSe on Pathways

```{r lefse-pathway, warning=FALSE}
# Clean pathway names for microbiomeMarker compatibility
ps_lefse     <- ps_filtered
orig_names   <- taxa_names(ps_lefse)
clean_names  <- gsub("[|\\[\\]\\.\\-: ]", "_", orig_names)
taxa_names(ps_lefse) <- clean_names

tax_mat <- matrix(taxa_names(ps_lefse), nrow = ntaxa(ps_lefse), ncol = 1)
rownames(tax_mat) <- taxa_names(ps_lefse)
colnames(tax_mat) <- "Pathway"
tax_table(ps_lefse) <- tax_table(tax_mat)
sample_data(ps_lefse)$Enterotype <- droplevels(
  sample_data(ps_lefse)$Enterotype)

lefse_result <- tryCatch(
  run_lefse(ps_lefse, group = "Enterotype", taxa_rank = "Pathway",
            wilcoxon_cutoff = pval_cutoff, lda_cutoff = lda_cutoff,
            norm = "none"),
  error = function(e) { cat("LEfSe error:", e$message, "\n"); NULL }
)

if (!is.null(lefse_result)) {
  marker_tbl <- marker_table(lefse_result)
  marker_tbl$p_adjust <- p.adjust(marker_tbl$pvalue, method = "fdr")

  # Restore names
  name_map <- setNames(orig_names, clean_names)
  marker_tbl$feature <- name_map[marker_tbl$feature]

  cat("LEfSe pathway markers:", nrow(marker_tbl), "\n")

  p_bar <- tryCatch(plot_ef_bar(lefse_result), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(p_bar)) {
    print(p_bar)
    ggsave(file.path(output_dir, paste0(prefix, "pathway_LEfSe_barplot.png")),
           p_bar, width = 10, height = max(6, nrow(marker_tbl) * 0.25), dpi = 300)
  }

  write_xlsx(list(
    All_Markers = as.data.frame(marker_tbl)
  ), file.path(output_dir, paste0(prefix, "pathway_LEfSe_results.xlsx")))
}
```
